description: Improve the merged affine-8 engine by enabling BF16 routed expert-down output storage for fused prefill, retaining FP32 matmul/combine accumulation, shared/residual outputs and recurrent state. The base full report measures 2547.7 prefill tokens/s against the inherited 3113 goal. Hypothesis: halving routed-output bytes improves prefill throughput while preserving endpoint conformance and task accuracy within acceptable numerical tolerance. Evaluate merged engine PR #20 with --bf16-expert-output, otherwise preserve the base serving configuration, including dispatch mask 29, staged8 recurrence, fused preparation, FP16 KV/operands, BF16 DFlash2 draft, 2048-token chunks and 32768 context. Shared-gate sigmoid and fused affine dense alternatives remain disabled. Run all eight Full tests. Pin current main for the evaluator; its definition and evaluator source files are byte-identical to the base pin. Report all outcomes without attributing cross-report timing variation solely to this change.
